I'm a data scientist with a PhD in Physics from New York University, working at the
intersection of **quantitative forecasting and AI agent systems**. I build
production-grade pipelines end-to-end — from data ingestion through modelling,
validation, and deployment to monitoring — whether the model is a time-series
forecaster for energy markets or a multi-stage LLM agent that verifies its own
answers. My work centres on **forecasting and uncertainty quantification,
LLM-based agents with built-in verification, and turning complex data into
decisions people can trust**. I value reproducible, open work and clear
communication of technical results to specialist and non-technical audiences
alike.

## Selected projects

### 🔍 Determine — a scientific claim-verification agent
*"LLMs sound convincing even when they're wrong. Determine finds out whether
they're right."* An answer engine that is also its own fact-checker: it drafts
literature-grounded, cited answers, decomposes them into typed atomic claims,
then independently verifies every claim with a **blind verifier from a different
model family** (fresh retrieval, independence asserted at startup) and re-computes
the numbers with a sandboxed checker — reporting an auditable faithfulness score
(SUPPORTED / REFUTED / NEI) with a clickable evidence trail. Built as a
LangGraph-orchestrated pipeline (plan → retrieve → answer → decompose →
verify ∥ compute), with hallucination-injection tests and fully persisted run
states.

[Code](https://github.com/liudi23/determine/tree/mvp)

### 🌡️ Heatwave stress on the GB balancing system
How extreme heat reshapes the imbalance (cash-out) price and the ~18:00 evening
spike — a climate-resilience analysis that ranks the physical drivers rather than
just predicting price. Open data (Elexon BMRS, Sheffield PV_Live, Open-Meteo),
an interpretable decomposition, and a live results app.

[Read the writeup](posts/heatwave-imbalance/index.qmd) ·
[Code](https://github.com/liudi23/heatwave-imbalance)

### ⚡ GB imbalance-price forecasting pipeline
An end-to-end pipeline for short-term GB system-price forecasting — data ingestion,
feature engineering, model training, and monitoring in production, with a Streamlit
dashboard.

[Live app](https://uk-system-price-forecast.streamlit.app/) ·
[Code](https://github.com/liudi23/uk-system-price-forecast)
